No decisions were made at this meeting, and participants generally agreed that it would be useful to discuss these issues further at upcoming meetings. It was agreed that the next meeting of the Committee would be held on Tuesday-Wednesday, December 16-17, 2014. The meeting adjourned at 12:45 p.m. on October 29, 2014.
